subject: Request: Exec approval for custom onboarding + retainer concession (CoreWare)
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lindsey Park <lindsey@coreware.io>; CoreWare Procurement <procurement@coreware.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Support retainer & integration scope for CoreWare - SOW attached

Hi Lindsey,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team was excited by the low-latency routing we showed. Per our conversation, I’m attaching an updated SOW that includes the accelerated onboarding plan and a tentative pricing table (see pricing_breakdown_coreware.csv). The SOW outlines a 12-week integration window with a custom connector for CoreWare’s ingestion pipeline and a premium retainer that includes a named SSE for the first 90 days.

Questions for you before we finalize:
- Can you confirm the target go-live by Sep 1?
- Are there any compliance constraints for the connector (data residency, encryption-at-rest requirements)?

Ben and Rishi are on-copy; we’ll need to route if any concessions on pricing or scope are required.

Attachments: SOW_CoreWare_v3.pdf, Integration_Spec_CoreWare.xlsx

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0182
From: Lindsey Park <lindsey@coreware.io>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 11:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Support retainer & integration scope for CoreWare - SOW attached

Thanks Naomi — the SOW looks thorough. A couple of asks from our side:

1) Pricing: we were hoping for a first-year concession — our procurement budget is front-loaded and we’d like a 30% reduction on the retainer for year one if we can get the advanced onboarding included.
2) Timeline: we can do Sep 1 go-live if onboarding starts June 15, so the accelerated timeline is a hard requirement.
3) Connector: our security team will need the integration spec reviewed for PII handling; they’ll send a checklist by Friday.

If Redwood can accommodate the 30% concession and the named SSE + two-week hands-on kickoff, we’re prepared to route the contract to our procurement team next week.

Regards,
Lindsey Park
VP, Product Operations
CoreWare Inc
lindsey@coreware.io
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lindsey Park <lindsey@coreware.io>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Support retainer & integration scope for CoreWare - exec review requested

Ben / Rishi — forwarding CoreWare asks. They want a 30% first-year discount on the premium retainer plus the named SSE and a two-week hands-on kickoff (accelerated onboarding). They’re committed to the Sep 1 target if we start June 15.

Quick context: this is a mid-market ARR opportunity with potential expansion into a dedicated capacity contract next year. Standard policy caps discounts at 20% without exec sign-off; the request is for 30%. The custom connector scope is non-trivial (see Integration_Spec_CoreWare.xlsx).

Can you advise:
- What are the margin and runway implications of 30% off the retainer (see attached pricing_breakdown_coreware.csv)?
- Can we commit a named SSE for the first 90 days and a two-week embedded kickoff?
- If we need exec sign-off, who should I loop in for approval and what materials will they need?

Thanks — I’d like to provide Lindsey an answer by EOD Friday.

—Naomi
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Support retainer & integration scope for CoreWare - exec review requested

Naomi — thanks for the heads-up and the attachments. High-level take:

- Margin: at 30% concession on the first-year retainer the deal is borderline but acceptable given the likelihood of expansion into Dedicated next year. We’ll need to protect gross margin in year two (add an automatic reversion to list pricing in year two).
- SSE commitment: we can allocate a named SSE for 90 days and run the two-week kickoff, but it will require temporary re-prioritization of one implementation resource (I’ll coordinate with CS).
- Approval needed: because this exceeds the 20% discount threshold we need an exec-level exception. Recommend escalation to Jasmine Liu (VP, Customer Success) and include a one-page summary for the CRO outlining: ARR, first-year concession amount, expected upsell trajectory, and risk mitigations (auto-reversion, milestones for success).

I drafted suggested concession language below for the SOW: 
"Redwood will provide a one-time 30% concession on the premium retainer for contract year one. Contract year two and beyond revert to list pricing unless a written renewal agreement is signed. CoreWare will receive a named SSE for a 90-day period and a two-week embedded kickoff. Concession is contingent on CoreWare signing within 10 business days of the final SOW and meeting milestone 1 (kickoff completion)."

If Naomi can pull together the one-pager and the updated SOW with the concession clause, I’ll route to Jasmine and cc the finance owner.

Ben
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lindsey Park <lindsey@coreware.io>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Escalation: Exec sign-off requested for 30% concession + custom connector for CoreWare (deal CW-2027-047)

Jasmine — requesting your approval for an exception to our standard discount policy for CoreWare (deal CW-2027-047). Below is a concise summary for your review.

Summary:
- Account: CoreWare Inc (mid-market SaaS)
- Requested concession: 30% off the premium onboarding retainer for contract year one (standard max 20%)
- Added commitments: named SSE for 90 days; two-week embedded kickoff; delivery of a custom ingestion connector as defined in Integration_Spec_CoreWare.xlsx
- Timeline: onboarding to start June 15 to support Sep 1 go-live
- Commercial terms to protect Redwood: Year two reverts to list pricing automatically unless a written renewal is executed; concession contingent on contract signature within 10 business days and milestone-based acceptance criteria in SOW
- Rationale: High probability of upsell to Dedicated capacity in year two; strategic reference potential within the vertical; volume anchor for Q3 pipeline
- Financial impact: first-year margin reduction ~3.8% on blended ARR (see pricing_breakdown_coreware.csv).

Requested action: please confirm approval to grant the 30% first-year concession and the custom connector scope. If approved, I will update the SOW to include Ben’s concession language and route to CoreWare procurement immediately.

Attachments: SOW_CoreWare_v3.pdf, Integration_Spec_CoreWare.xlsx, pricing_breakdown_coreware.csv

—Naomi Feldman
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0182
